edition: Complete unofficial Korean translation; original 50-page packet

translation.authoring: Directly authored locally without translation APIs or keys.

font_and_layout.source_fonts: Original Type3 CharProc outlines converted to CFF OTF with original advances and exact contours; explicit per-character routing to original drawable coverage, including regular, bold, italic and bold italic faces. Original TTF and Base14 faces retained.
font_and_layout.korean_fonts: Noto Sans KR 400/700 follows the original sans serif body style. Original Latin fonts contain no Hangul.
font_and_layout.paragraph_start_anchors: 13 grouped-list regions segmented at original logical paragraph start positions; original vector bullet marks retained and aligned.
font_and_layout.heading_underlining: Original page 7 heading underline rectangle is repeated with exactly its native bounds and color above the translated text layer to avoid text-box knockout gaps.
font_and_layout.emphasis: Original bold headings/question codes and physical instrument button labels retained; original red answer-sheet warnings retained.

source_notes: All 50 actual pages are included: 7 general instruction pages plus 43 physics, chemistry and biology practical pages. Original packet page-number sequences are retained.

The instructions refer to separate subject answer sheets. Those sheets are not included in this question-paper PDF. Blank example/result tables printed within questions are retained, with the original warnings to use separate answer sheets.

All 28 non-logo scientific photos, graphs, chemical diagrams and anatomical figures are kept completely native. Their text consists of physical instrument button/mode identifiers, scientific symbols, numbers, units and anatomical letter codes; the anatomical legend is translated in the body. No explanatory English figure labels were omitted.
Original material list says pH 4.00, while calibration instructions say pH 4.01. Both values are retained.
Repeated examination-rule numbering is retained. Apparatus and answer-sheet namespace identifiers such as P_Experiment, P_Task, C_Table and STR locus codes are kept to match the original materials.
Source context resolves wooden pallets as wooden sticks and lactin/succonic acid as lactic/succinic acid in Korean. No experimental values or procedures are changed.
Plant key Latin taxon identifiers are preserved in their original italic faces. The source label Sequoia (Sequoioideae) is preserved despite its mixed taxonomic ranks.

A separate public reprint of physics marking notes (5 images) and chemistry DEMO answer examples (2 images) has been found; it is not included in this question-paper file. No biology key or separate official blank answer sheets have been acquired.

renderer_qa.warnings: Original JP2 images decode through fallback; host fontconfig display-font warnings. Same warning multiset on original and Korean files.
